fusions.name: False Opening
fusions.desc: Drops your guard, then slams it back up, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Each has a 40% chance to be confused for 3 seconds and attack its own side.

fusions.name: Sucker Punch
fusions.desc: A hidden blow from behind your shield that deals 26 damage to a target at or below 25% health, and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Decoy Challenge
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. A fox decoy fights beside you for 8 seconds, biting for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Feint Ledger
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
